summary: The filing is a Form 6-K reporting a major holding notification under Irish disclosure rules, equivalent to a Schedule 13G/13D amendment in the US. It details that The Capital Group Companies, Inc. crossed below the 17% threshold of Ryanair Holdings PLC voting rights as of July 24, 2026, holding 16.91% (175,766,571 voting rights) across depository receipts and ordinary shares. No price, premium, board recommendation, or strategic action is stated. This is a routine passive cross-threshold disclosure reflecting ordinary portfolio activity, not a special situation or event-driven catalyst. No risk-arb angle or structural note applies.
